cog_components.region: bottom left of the original last-sheet target

method: Construct exactly 18 frames in three six-frame columns: two unturned and one quarter-turned. Use the audited nine-cog square over the two shorter columns, one cog over the taller column and the five-cog row on the last sheet, preserving every source transform before translation normalization. Use 0.225mm bounding clearance. This changes the narrow four-tall-column residual strip into a wider right strip, but does not presume bracket feasibility. Recompute every original member, allowed transform, stock bound and all same-sheet filled-outer pairs, and validate the resulting 33-part subassembly with the frozen original CLI. Report every historical mixed-orientation column pattern; do not claim a first-ever frame orientation. No bracket/insert completion or solver is performed. This prepares a changed construction after the checked all-wide and all-tall frame searches; it is not a full-job witness, production repair or native-margin qualification.
